kept.title: SSE protocol docblock still advertises `details` on error events
kept.desc: The `streamLlm` JSDoc continues to document `event: error — { error: "message", details: "..." }`, but the catch block now emits only `{ error: message }`; any client written against this contract will read `undefined`.

kept.title: `errorWithDetails` payload is now unreachable
kept.desc: With `getErrorDetails` deleted, nothing in the process reads the attached `details` property, so the new comment's claim that it "remains attached ... for any in-process consumer that opts in" describes a consumer that does not exist; the OpenRouter error body is now silently discarded, removing the only diagnostic for non-2xx streaming failures.

kept.title: Exported `getAnthropicClient` renamed without compatibility alias
kept.desc: Only `streamLlm.ts` is updated in this diff; any other importer (route handlers, existing tests, mocks referencing `getAnthropicClient`) would break at build time, and the rename is not noted anywhere as a breaking change.

kept.title: Comment's stated rationale conflicts with the adjacent response
kept.desc: The comment argues `responseText` "shouldn't end up in server logs" because it derives from user source material, yet the very next statement returns a 500-char slice of it in the HTTP body, so the redaction is partial and the justification reads as stronger than the actual behavior.
